name: fladder
description: A cross-platform Jellyfin frontend built on Flutter. Provides a media client for browsing and playing content from Jellyfin media servers with support for movies, TV series, music, live TV, books, and photos. Includes offline sync, transcode settings, picture-in-picture, TV/leanback UI, and integrations with Seerr (Overseerr/Request) for media requests.
